egpPoints.point: Present simple affirmative, third person singular -s with common verbs
Spelling variants -es (sh/ch/x) and -ies (consonant+y) in third person
egpPoints.egpLevel: A1 (no separate A2 EGP point recalled; spelling is not graded separately)

egpPoints.point: Present simple used for habits/routines with frequency adverbs

outcomes.itemsTest: A1 point: all items (gap-fill -s/-es/-ies, choice, -s omission and spelling error correction, routine sentences, I->he transfer) test 3rd-person -s form; spelling items add difficulty but not an A2 EGP point.
outcomes.evidence: Statement 'add -s or -es after he, she, it' matches the EGP A1 form point; outcome reference itself says A1-A2. A2 placement defensible only as remediation for Arabic-L1 -s omission (accuracy target), not by EGP level.

egpPoints.point: Present continuous affirmative (am/is/are + -ing) for actions happening now
Present continuous contrasted with present simple (choice after Listen!/Look!)

outcomes.itemsTest: Both: items 1-3, 5-8 test the A1 form point (be + -ing, be omission); item 4 (simple vs continuous) and item 6 (bare verb for action now) touch the A2 contrast/use point; item 9 is A1-A2 production.
outcomes.evidence: Statement covers only the A1 form; A2 value lies in the simple/continuous contrast which only 1-2 items test. Either relabel A1, or keep A2 and add contrast items.

egpPoints.point: Can I ...? to ask for things/permission (requests)
Would like (I'd like / I would like) for polite requests and wants
CEFR CV Transactions to obtain goods and services: A1 ask for things and give things; A2 ask for and provide everyday goods and services, ordering a meal

outcomes.itemsTest: A1 exponents (Can I have, I would like, please) in A2 transactional contexts (shop, cinema, cafe, hotel/pharmacy message transfer); item 9 written transfer leans A2.
outcomes.evidence: Linguistic exponents are A1 in EGP (parent EN-L-A1-FN-polite-requests exists); the transactional scope (ordering, services) aligns with CV A2. Could/May accepted in item 1 extends beyond A1. Keep A2 only if framed by task context; otherwise A1.
